title: Beyond the 956: Mona Guilmáin, Mexican actress of the famed Guilmáin family, dies
excerpt: Mona Guilmáin, the Mexican actress, theater promoter and art dealer from one of Mexico's most storied acting families, died November 18, 2026. Her death was confirmed by the National Association of Interpreters (ANDI).
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Mona Guilmáin, the Mexican actress, theater promoter, music producer and art dealer from one of Mexico's most storied acting families, has died.

Guilmáin died Wednesday, November 18, 2026, the National Association of Interpreters (ANDI) confirmed in a message shared on its social media. Las Estrellas (Televisa) and Lado.mx also reported her death. No cause of death has been publicly disclosed.

Guilmáin was the daughter of Ofelia Guilmáin, the legendary Spanish-born first actress who arrived in Mexico in 1941 and built a celebrated career in theater, film and television, including Luis Buñuel's El ángel exterminador and the telenovela La antorcha encendida.

Her siblings were also part of Mexican entertainment: her brother Juan Ferrara, a well-known actor with a long career in television, film and theater, and her sister Lucía Guilmáin, an actress remembered for telenovelas including La Dueña, ¡Amigos x Siempre!, Corazón salvaje and Un refugio para el amor, who died in February 2021. Her sister Esther Guilmáin was also part of the artistic family.

ANDI identified Mona Guilmáin as an actress, music producer and art dealer, and she also worked as a theater promoter and restorer. Her death is a new loss for a family whose artistic legacy has touched generations of Mexican entertainment.

Rest in Peace, Mona Guilmáin.

Sources: Las Estrellas (Televisa); Lado.mx; Asociación Nacional de Intérpretes (ANDI).
